script: When she texts good morning, never just say it back. Say this, and she'll think about you all day. Most guys write back, morning! Did you sleep well? It's nice, but nobody remembers nice. Say this instead: Morning. I'm still smiling about last night. Or, coffee's better with you. Saturday? Anyone can say good morning. Only the right man makes her morning. Be that man.
